questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

Some elephants are horses.

No horse is a donkey.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No elephant is a donkey.

(II) No horse is an elephant.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some elephants are horses.

No horse is a donkey.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/082e99fe019af09963281fe395c71f41f5e91a92e745a90b8838f2063d6ef494.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No elephant is a donkey - **Does not follow** (Only horses are definitely not donkeys. Other elephants may or may not be donkeys).

II. No horse is an elephant - **Does not follow** (Given statement says some elephants are horses, so some horses are elephants).

So, Neither follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

questions.question: All 81 people are standing in a row facing the north. Mr. Hepa is 11th from the left end, while Mr. Annu is 16th from the right end. How many people are there between Mr. Hepa and Mr. Annu?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Number of persons between two persons in a row = Total Persons − (Position from Left + Position from Right)**

Now, Total Persons = 81

Mr. Hepa = 11th from the Left

Mr. Annu = 16th from the Right

⇒ Number of persons between them = 81 − (11 + 16)

⇒ Number of persons between them = 81 − 27

⇒ Number of persons between them = 54

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 3.**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

189 – 153 × 9 ÷ 3 + 195 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 189 – 153 × 9 ÷ 3 + 195 = ?

Now, if + and − are interchanged and × and ÷ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 189 + 153 ÷ 9 × 3 − 195

⇒ 153 ÷ 9 = 17

⇒ 17 × 3 = 51

⇒ 189 + 51 − 195

⇒ 240 − 195 = 45

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All glasses are tiles.

All glasses are cups.

All cups are mugs.

**Conclusions:**

(I): All glasses are mugs.

(II): Some cups are tiles.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All glasses are tiles.

All glasses are cups.

All cups are mugs.

II. Some cups are tiles - Follows (Glasses are common to both cups and tiles, therefore some cups are tiles).

So, both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
